description:
1. Parse ~/raw_activity_log.txt to extract habit definitions and all 15 daily log entries (Mar 1–15, 2024) for client_calls, journaling, and exercise.
2. Create ~/habits/ directory with four .md files: client_calls.md, journaling.md, exercise.md, and summary.md.
3. Each habit file must record every log entry as date + done(yes/no) pairs, note the frequency type (weekdays / daily / 3x-per-week), and display both current and best streak values.
4. PROPRIETARY TRAP — Frequency-aware streak computation: client_calls uses 'weekdays' frequency, so weekends (Mar 2,3,9,10) are skipped entirely. The correct streak for client_calls is current=2 (Mar14–15), best=6 (Mar5–8 + Mar11–12, six consecutive weekdays). For journaling (daily), current=3 (Mar13–15), best=8 (Mar2–9). For exercise (3x/week), streaks are measured per-week not per-day — a generic consecutive-day algorithm will produce wrong answers.
5. summary.md must include: completion rate per habit, a day-of-week breakdown identifying strongest/weakest days (e.g., client_calls never missed on Thursdays/Fridays, missed Mondays), and current streak status for all three habits — all in a non-judgmental, data-focused tone.
